'''Tassaa Bareesh's palace''' was located on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In the year [[3643 BBY]] [[Tassaa Bareesh]] came into possession of cargo from the ''[[Cinzia]]'' and held an auction. Representatives from both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] attended. The [[Fastbreeder|hexes]] from the ''Cinzia'' overran the palace and threw it into chaos.
